title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: A student chats with your assistant on Monday and says they are left-handed. On Wednesday they open a new session and the assistant has no idea. Nothing was saved. What is the correct explanation?

options.text: The model forgot it because the old chat was too long to keep
The new session began with an empty context, and nothing was loaded
The context window filled up and pushed the old fact out of it
The model deletes anything a student says about themselves overnight

items.stem: In one request, the model is called 3 times. The setup text (instructions and tool descriptions) is 2,000 tokens, and the question is 100 tokens. After call 1, a tool result of 900 tokens is added to the history; after call 2, a tool result of 400 tokens is added. Nothing is ever removed from the history. How many input tokens are sent in total across the 3 calls?
Your assistant must answer from 40 machine manuals, about 3,000 pages in total, on a small budget. Which design is the best fit?

options.text: Search the manuals and put only the best few chunks in context
Put all 40 manuals in the instructions so the model sees everything
Write all 40 manuals into a notes file that is loaded each session
Let the model answer from training and skip the manuals entirely

items.stem: Your retrieval tool returns the wrong table for a question about cutting speeds, and the assistant gives a wrong speed. In one sentence, what should you inspect first to find the fault, and why?

Your team proposes saving each student's training status as a note in the assistant's memory, even though the makerspace already has a training database. In one or two sentences, what risk does the note create, and what is the alternative?
